provenance: physical device timebase (TIMERAWL, 1 MHz watchdog tick); NOT emulated

calibration.note: 8 Thumb instructions verified by llvm-objdump at 0x100006e2; 7*1 + 2-3 for the taken branch predicts 9-10 cycles

workload_identity.note: identical to the ESP32 runs (6540/20), same seed and corpus, so the cross-ISA comparison is of the silicon

four_wide_verdict.mechanism: Cortex-M0+ has 8 low registers and Thumb-1 data ops cannot reach r8-r12; four accumulators plus base/pointer/index/counter do not fit, so accumulators spill to the stack every iteration

open.half_clock_discriminator: cargo build --release --features half-clock rebuilds PLL_SYS at 62.5 MHz; a physical timebase must report ~144 ns/iter, a host-wall-clock timer 72
